_about: Short plain-English phrase for each fact, used to write the reason on every flag.
subject_identity: the subject's name or another identifier
manner_of_entry: how the subject entered (for example, on foot without inspection)
place_of_entry: where the subject entered (an approximate location such as "near Brownsville, TX" is enough)
admitted_or_paroled_status: whether the subject was admitted or paroled
prior_removal_order: that the subject was previously ordered removed
prior_removal_date: the date of the prior removal order or removal
reentry_or_attempted_reentry: that the subject entered or tried to enter again after the removal
admitted_status_at_reentry: whether the subject was admitted when they came back
misrepresentation_or_fraud_act: the specific false statement or fraudulent act
benefit_or_admission_sought: the immigration benefit or admission the subject was seeking
stated_lawful_admission: a statement that the subject was lawfully admitted or paroled
no_prior_removal_stated: a statement that the subject was never removed
truthful_disclosure_stated: a statement that the subject made no misrepresentation
